sources.snippet: English | 中文 MuG Diffusion is a charting AI for rhythm games based on Stable Diffusion (one of the most powerful AIGC models) with a large modification to incorporate audio waves. Given an audio file, MuG Diffusion is able to generate high-quality diverse charts, which is aligned with the music and highly controllable.
